sheets.label: 礼服像素设定图
sheets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Produce a polished PIXEL ART CHARACTER DESIGN SHEET for a fantasy strategy RPG. This is a MULTI-VIEW CHARACTER MODEL SHEET, not merely an avatar. Work only from the supplied user-approved reference sheets, never any earlier generated portraits. Preserve the handsome youthful facial likeness, golden medium swept-back wavy hair, lean build and elegant proportions. Calm composed natural expression, no villain grin, no exaggerated scowl. All figures and details must be genuinely REDRAWN IN CRISP PIXEL ART: deliberate visible square clusters, stepped contours, limited harmonious colour ramps, controlled dithering, classic high-end 16-bit/32-bit game art. No photographic areas, no smooth painted illustration, no mosaic filter, no pasted photo snippets. Consistent native pixel scale across character views; larger pixel portrait and detailed material samples may have their own appropriate pixel scale. Clean dark charcoal/teal neutral studio board, subtle warm-gold panel separators, legible generous spacing, no candlelit scene backgrounds. Vertical 2:3 sheet, high resolution. Layout: two prominent full-body turnarounds FRONT and BACK in left half, equal scale feet fully visible; upper-right large head-and-shoulders portrait; middle-right uncrowned hairstyle FRONT and SIDE studies; bottom accessory/material detail tiles and five colour swatches. All views depict exactly the same man and outfit with consistent construction, no alternate outfits. Only brief clear English section labels; no paragraphs or quotes. CEREMONIAL COSTUME sheet. Title: 'JOFFREY — COURT'. Faithfully preserve attached design: ornate delicate gold antler crown, burgundy long high-collared coat densely woven with gold heraldic lions/floral scrollwork, asymmetric deep wine velvet drape over one shoulder reaching nearly to calf, black leather waist belt with rectangular ornate gold buckle, black slim trousers and tall black boots. Gold dark-stone ring. Elegant sheathed ceremonial sword at belt with gold fittings. Full-body FRONT and BACK wear crown; hairstyle studies are uncrowned. Do not invent armour. Detail tiles show crown, gold brocade pattern, velvet border, belt/buckle, ring and boot. The main portrait should closely match reference sheet's lower front/three-quarter face studies rather than caricature. Keep coat's silhouette, drape attachment and hem length consistent front/back. Pixel artist production model sheet, useful for future sprites and dialogue portraits.
